notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Ulasht.
Ulasht has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ulasht by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Necrosynthesis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ulasht.
Repeat.
